session.title: Suito low-aerobic continuity
session.purpose: Add recoverable aerobic volume between the week's two protected MTB exposures.
session.dose: Ride 50-65 minutes seated at 116-130 W and RPE 2-3 with steady cadence. No standing torque, tempo blocks or sprints.
session.adaptation_hypothesis: A low-aerobic touch maintains bike-specific oxidative work without consuming Friday's technical or race-bike capacity.
execution_rules: Use strong fan cooling and drink to thirst.
Keep power steady; do not turn good legs into an interval session.

expected_result.session: Stable breathing and legs with no meaningful late drift.
expected_result.next_day: Thursday feels suitable for rest or a very short primer.

stop_rules: Downshift or stop for abnormal HR response, worsening leg heaviness, pain, illness or CNS compromise.
